picks.title: Cloudflare security-audit-skill: multi-phase security audits for coding agents
picks.summary: A coding-agent skill that runs multi-phase security audits with independently verified, machine-checkable findings.
picks.implementation_idea: Run the skill against the radar-ingest Worker and dashboard repo as a weekend audit; publish the scorecard as a template other dashboard authors can copy.
picks.reason: Strongest build idea in the feed

picks.title: DeepSeek Harness: everything-is-a-plugin agent harness
picks.summary: DeepSeek's official agent harness where every capability ships as a plugin, making agent stacks composable and swappable.
picks.implementation_idea: Write a radar-tracker plugin for the harness: each plugin polls one launch source and feeds candidates to a JEV decision layer for scoring and dedupe.

picks.title: OmniRoute
picks.summary: Free MIT AI gateway: one endpoint, 290+ providers and 500+ models with quota-aware auto-fallback.
picks.implementation_idea: Front the OpenRouter JEV calls with OmniRoute for provider fallback and token-compression savings.
picks.reason: Strongest build idea in the feed

picks.title: Nasiko: developer control plane for AI agents
picks.summary: Rust control plane giving developers one dashboard to deploy, monitor, and govern fleets of AI agents.
picks.implementation_idea: Point nasiko at the trading-droplet agent fleet: one control plane for Codex/Claude workers with kill-switches and spend caps visible per worker.
picks.reason: Strongest build idea in the feed
